origins_work.heading: What I’m working on
origins_work.lede: Three strands of the same question — one inside a school, one in research, one across a continent.

items.title: AI tooling for educators
items.detail: Introducing tools that can recall and synthesise information instantly — which is exactly what makes the assessment question urgent.

items.title: The Toddle transition
items.detail: Moving how we plan, document and report on learning, which means deciding what is worth capturing in the first place.

items.title: Educator Compass & the Digital Toolkit
items.detail: Platforms for evaluation, growth conversations, shared tools, and a single place for institutional knowledge to live.

items.title: Robotics tournament app
items.detail: An app for judging and grading engineering notebooks at robotics tournaments.

items.title: CI/CD for the technology team
items.detail: One lint gate required on every repository, release pull requests opened and tagged automatically, and CodeQL and dependency review any repository can switch on.

items.title: Privacy & governance
items.detail: The groundwork before any of this: student data handled properly, systems that hold up to scrutiny.

items.title: Nyuchi Learning
items.detail: Training, the open Bundu Education frameworks, and classroom tools built for African schools.

items.title: Mukoko Lingo
items.detail: Learning African languages, with Shona and Ndebele first.

items.title: Mukoko & Mukoko News
items.detail: A privacy-focused social platform, and pan-African news aggregated from trusted regional sources.

items.title: Mukoko Weather
items.detail: Forecasts and frost alerts for farming, mining, border posts and travel, built on the Foundation's open Weather Commons.

items.title: Mukoko Events
items.detail: Community events and gatherings — grown out of nhimbe, the Shona tradition of working a field together.

items.title: The Bundu Foundation
items.detail: A Zimbabwean research foundation. Its main work is mapping infrastructure gaps in African and emerging markets and publishing the answers in the open.

items.title: Open standards and research
items.detail: Standards, frameworks and benchmarks that schools, builders and governments can adopt for free, including Mzizi: the design system this ecosystem is built with, and a research programming language still in Phase 0.

items.title: Bundu Weather Commons
items.detail: Open weather and agricultural data for Africa, held by the Foundation: ground readings, blended forecasts, climate normals and farm datasets, every record attributed.

origins_work.note: The Nyuchi work was built for places where credentials were never the thing that got you through. That is the same instinct I bring to the work at school.
